method: All 18 refreshed compatible-build images individually opened and visually inspected through view_image. No post-processing.

images.observation: Clear Queries heading, search, owner and favorites controls; aligned rows; cache scope disclosed; new-query action unobscured.
Saved Query label agrees with clean source; SQL highlighting is legible; toolbar clears the context handle; empty results state is distinct.
Waiting state and cancel controls are visible; Run is disabled during the active attempt; editor and dock retain their positions.
Three result rows, schema labels, success state and preview bounds are legible; table aligns by ordinal and remains inside the workspace.
Expanded snapshot shows run, warehouse, start, hash and executed SQL; long hash wraps within its column and details remain readable.
Parameter name/value/type/NULL controls are distinct; dirty source label is correct; NULL cell differs from text and singular row copy is correct.
Server refusal is prominent above source; previous successful output remains labeled stale; error does not cover editor or result controls.
Terminal Canceled is distinct from pending cancellation; Run is available again; no fabricated result rows are displayed.
Own-history tab is selected; three runs have aligned status and Open snapshot controls; history remains separate from chat sessions.
Dark app shell and editor agree; syntax, input surfaces and action text are legible; captured after theme/editor readiness.
375px editor layout wraps header and toolbar; warehouse remains usable; Editor/Results controls and composer fit without horizontal page overflow.
375px results view has visible success/count, schema, exact value and copy action; query toolbar and output tabs remain usable.
768px view shows editor and results together; controls wrap cleanly; composer remains separate below the document workspace.
Snapshot notice and query attachment chip are visible; current source remains readable; dock and document actions do not overlap.
Centered review dialog has readable destination/effects, visible name focus ring, and separated Cancel/Create controls.
One completed SQL proposal appears with Ready state; Open as query has contrasting light text on a dark code header; code remains horizontally scrollable.
Private draft opens in the shared tabs with proposed SQL and empty results; completed assistant proposal remains visible; no automatic run is represented.
Lost-response explanation wraps within the dialog; original destination remains visible and frozen; Check again clearly recovers the existing request.
